sources.snippet: Qwen Image 2.1 is Alibaba's 7-billion-parameter open-weight image model (September 2026), notable for native RGBA transparency and running on consumer GPUs. The base checkpoint isn't trained for explicit content, but the open weights invite uncensored community fine-tunes.
